findings.description: The death of a Григорий Кокоша, aged 25, on 18 September 1846, recorded in the 1846 death register of the church of St John the Theologian (Иоанно-Богословская церковь), Жидовская Гребля, Tarashcha, Kiev (index ark:/61903/1:1:KX55-44K), is a genuine entry in Григорий Захаров Кокоша's own parish, where his daughter Анна was baptised in February 1844, but it cannot be assigned to him with confidence. The index gives only a given name, surname and age: no patronymic (his marriage and his daughter's baptism both name him Григорий Захариев) and no widow (his wife was Татьяна Иванова). The register page could not be read reliably, and the Kokosha family was numerous in the parish, so a namesake cannot be excluded. Pass = the report engages the 18 September 1846 death entry and presents it as a probable or possible death for Григорий Захаров Кокоша, leaving the identification explicitly qualified because the entry names no patronymic or spouse. Fail = it states as established that Григорий Захаров Кокоша died on 18 September 1846 without qualifying the identification. A report that leaves the death undated without engaging the 18 September 1846 entry does not pass: failing to find or confirm a death is not this finding.
